title: Harness session metadata
description: Schema for kpis/data/raw/sessions/<harness>/<sessionId>.meta.json, written by the session-start hook when a Claude Code or OpenCode session starts and completed by the session-end hook (endedAt, sampled, samplingReason). Records what was invoked, by whom, against which company and where the transcript lives, so summaries and KPIs can be attributed

sessionId.description: Harness session id; also the file stem of the meta, summary, transcript and export files

harness.description: Harness that ran the session; must be 'claude-code' or 'opencode' for ingested sessions and matches the parent folder name

harnessVersion.description: Harness release, e.g. the Claude Code 'version' field on transcript records or the OpenCode CLI version. Omit when the harness does not report it; never write a placeholder

runId.description: Headless run the session belongs to (MAXWELL_RUN_ID); omitted for interactive sessions

workflow.description: Workflow the session executed; 'manual' for ad-hoc interactive sessions

companyId.description: Company the workflow was invoked for; omitted for utility workflows with no company argument

args.description: Parsed workflow arguments and flags as invoked

appIds.description: Applications the workflow was restricted to; omitted when it covered all applications of the company

envIds.description: Environments the workflow was restricted to

dryRun.description: Whether --dry-run was passed (runtime probes plan and request evidence instead of executing)

startedAt.description: Timestamp of the first transcript record

endedAt.description: Timestamp of the last transcript record; absent while the session is still running

gitBranch.description: Git branch checked out in cwd when the session started

gitCommit.description: HEAD commit in cwd when the session started

transcriptPath.description: Workspace path of the copied transcript (Claude Code JSONL or OpenCode message JSONL): kpis/data/raw/sessions/<harness>/<sessionId>.jsonl next to this file. The harness folder must match harness

exportPath.description: Workspace path of the harness's own export (OpenCode `opencode export`): kpis/data/raw/sessions/<harness>/<sessionId>.export.json next to this file, when one was produced. The harness folder must match harness

sampled.description: Whether this session is included in KPI measurement under the registry sampling settings. Decided by the session-end hook, so set together with endedAt (or write false with samplingReason pending while the session runs)

samplingReason.description: Why sampled has its value: the registry mode that selected (sampled true) or skipped (sampled false) it, 'forced' when MAXWELL_KPI_SAMPLE=1 overrode the sampler, or 'pending' while the session is still running and no decision has been taken (sampled false only)

model.description: Primary model id the session was started with (gen_ai.request.model), e.g. 'claude-opus-5'

invokedBy.description: Who started the session: a human operator, a scheduler script or a parent agent

cwd.description: Working directory the harness ran in: either an absolute POSIX path or a path relative to the workspace root

sessionFilePath.description: Workspace path under kpis/data/raw/sessions/<harness>/; the per-harness allOf branches pin the folder and suffix
